environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed inside VPC (subnet-0a3f8c, subnet-0b7d2e) with no internet gateway or NAT. S3 access exclusively via com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x4a9f3b2c1d). The VPC endpoint has a custom endpoint policy that restricts PutObject operations with a condition: aws:ResourceTag/content-validated must equal 'true' on the target object, AND the request must include x-amz-meta-sanitized header set to 'html-escaped'. Since the Lambda code does NOT set this metadata header on put_object calls and new objects cannot have the required resource tag at creation time, all PutObject calls from this Lambda through the VPC endpoint are denied by the endpoint policy. The Lambda can still perform GetObject and ListBucket for reading existing (pre-validated) comments. Additionally, there is no other network path to S3 (no NAT, no internet gateway, no other VPC endpoint).

config.vpc: vpc-0xf8a3b2 with private subnets only, no IGW, no NAT
config.api_gateway: REST API, no WAF, no request validators
config.network_isolation: no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, no peering connections with internet access
